title: Post-MVP housekeeping
description: Coordinate post-MVP cleanup after the completed MVP epic. Scope: refresh stale public docs, run targeted review passes for correctness/completeness/technical debt, decide CLI distribution, and document where static and live databases live for users.
acceptance_criteria: README no longer describes the project as pre-MVP; correctness, completeness, and technical-debt review findings are captured as follow-up beads; CLI distribution approach is documented with release steps; user-facing storage locations for static content, live campaign SQLite DBs, Dolt checkpoints, and secret handling are documented.
close_reason: All five children complete (d4r.1–d4r.5). Post-MVP housekeeping done: ADR 0004 storage design implemented and merged (PR #40), CLI distribution and storage docs in place, review-finding beads filed.
